data.name: Elmer
data.gender_notes: Elmer is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old English word ‘elm’, which means ‘noble, famous, or powerful’. The name Elmer was given to warriors and nobles in the Middle Ages. The name Elmer carries the meaning “Famous warrior” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English. Parents who choose Elmer usually hope their child will grow to embody famous warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Carry the strength and courage of a noble warrior within.
data.etymology: Elmer belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Famous warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Elmer total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_hebrew.name: אלמר
in_hebrew.meaning: אלמר הוא שם שפירושו אלוהים הוא מפורסם או אלוהים הוא נודע
in_hebrew.long_meaning: אלמר הוא שם שמקורו בגרמנית ופירושו 'אלוהים הוא מפורסם' או 'אלוהים הוא נודע'. השם אלמר מורכב משני חלקים: 'אל' שפירושו אלוהים ו'מר' שפירושו מפורסם או נודע. השם אלמר נמצא בשימוש בקרב הנוצרים והוא נחשב לשם חזק ומשמעותי.

in_greek.name: Έλμερ
in_greek.meaning: Το Έλμερ σημαίνει Θεός είναι διάσημος ή Θεός είναι γνωστός
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Έλμερ είναι όνομα γερμανικής προέλευσης που σημαίνει 'Θεός είναι διάσημος' ή 'Θεός είναι γνωστός'. Το όνομα Έλμερ αποτελείται από δύο μέρη: 'Θεός' που σημαίνει Θεός και 'μερ' που σημαίνει διάσημος ή γνωστός. Το όνομα Έλμερ χρησιμοποιείται από τους Χριστιανούς και θεωρείται ισχυρό και σημαντικό όνομα.

in_latin.name: Elmerus
in_latin.meaning: Elmerus significat Deus est famosus vel Deus est notus
in_latin.long_meaning: Elmerus est nomen origine germanica quod significat 'Deus est famosus' vel 'Deus est notus'. Nomen Elmerus constat ex duabus partibus: 'Deus' quod significat Deus et 'mer' quod significat famosus vel notus. Nomen Elmerus in usu est apud Christianos et habetur pro nomine valido et significativo.

in_english.name: Elmer
in_english.meaning: Elmer means 'God is famous' or 'God is known'
in_english.long_meaning: Elmer is a Christian name of Germanic origin, meaning 'God is famous' or 'God is known'. The name Elmer is derived from two elements: 'God' or 'El' and 'mer' or 'meri', which means famous or known. The name Elmer has been used by Christians for centuries and is considered a strong and meaningful name. It is associated with qualities such as spirituality, faith, and devotion.

data.cultural_impact: The name Elmer has a rich historical background as it was commonly used among the Anglo-Saxon population in Europe, particularly in England. In the Middle Ages, Elmer was a name given to powerful and noble warriors who embodied strength and courage. Over time, the name evolved to be associated with strong and determined individuals in various cultures and communities.
